Node.description: The simplest node. Use it to group other nodes, or to run a script that doesn't need a position.

find.doc: A child by name, or a descendant by path ("UI/Score"); nil if there isn't one.

add.doc: Adds a node as the last child; returns it.

destroy.doc: Removes the node and its children from the scene at the end of the frame.

addToGroup.doc: Puts the node in a group, so smitten.scene.group(name) finds it.

removeFromGroup.doc: Takes the node out of a group.

inGroup.doc: True if the node is in the group.

on.doc: Calls fn(...) whenever the node's event happens ("pressed", "entered", ...). Returns a handle with :off().

emit.doc: Fires an event: calls the script's function of that name and every listener.

getPath.doc: The node's path from the scene's root, e.g. "Level1/Player".

isInside.doc: True while the node is in the running scene.

ready.doc: The node and its children have entered the scene.

update.doc: Every frame. dt is the time since the last frame, in seconds.

physicsUpdate.doc: 60 times a second, before physics moves bodies. Use it for movement.

draw.doc: 2D only: draw extra things on top of the node, in its own coordinates.

removed.doc: The node is leaving the scene.

Timer.description: Counts down and fires timeout(). Use it for spawn waves, cooldowns and delays.

autostart.description: Start counting as soon as the scene starts.

oneShot.description: Stop after the first timeout instead of repeating.

Node2D.description: A node with a 2D position, rotation and scale. Its children move with it.

y.description: Position, relative to the parent. y grows downwards.

rotation.description: Rotation in radians (degrees in the inspector), clockwise.

visible.description: Draw this node and its children.

tint.description: Multiplies the colors of this node and its children.

z.description: Draw order: higher is drawn on top. Equal z keeps the order of the scene tree.

getGlobalPosition.doc: Position in the scene (not relative to the parent): x, y.

setGlobalPosition.doc: Moves the node to a position in the scene.

toGlobal.doc: A point in this node's coordinates, in scene coordinates.

toLocal.doc: A point in scene coordinates, in this node's coordinates.

lookAt.doc: Rotates the node to face a point in the scene.

distanceTo.doc: Distance in pixels to another node or a point.

angleTo.doc: Angle in radians towards another node or a point.

moveToward.doc: Moves at most distance pixels towards a point; true once it's there.

translate.doc: Moves the node by an offset.

Sprite2D.description: Draws an image, or an animation from a .sprite file or a sprite sheet.

image.description: An image (.png, .jpg) or a .sprite file with frames and animations.

animation.description: The animation to play, from the .sprite file.

speed.description: Animation speed: 2 is twice as fast.

hframes.description: Columns in a sprite sheet image without a .sprite file.

vframes.description: Rows in a sprite sheet image without a .sprite file.

centered.description: Center the image on the node's position (a .sprite file's origin wins).

play.doc: Plays an animation (or resumes the current one).

stop.doc: Stops the animation on the current frame.

getSize.doc: Width and height of one frame, in pixels.

finished.doc: A non-looping animation reached its last frame.

Shape2D.description: Draws a rectangle, circle, polygon or line. Good for prototypes, effects and games without art.

points.description: Corner points x1, y1, x2, y2, ...

filled.description: Fill the shape; off draws only its outline.

centered.description: Center the rectangle on the node's position.

Text2D.description: Text in the game world, like a sign or a damage number. For menus and scores, use Label.

font.description: A .ttf/.otf font file, "pixel" for the built-in pixel font, or empty for the default font.

align.description: Horizontal alignment around the node's position.

wrap.description: Wrap lines longer than this; 0 never wraps.

TileMap.description: A grid of tiles from a tileset, painted in the scene view. Tiles marked solid in the tileset are walls and floors.

tileset.description: The .tileset file: an image cut into tiles, with properties such as solid.

layer.description: Collision layers the solid tiles are on.

getTile.doc: The tile number at a cell, or -1 if it's empty.

getTileProperties.doc: The properties set on a tile in the tileset (solid, name, ...).

worldToCell.doc: The cell under a point in the scene: cx, cy.

cellToWorld.doc: The scene position of a cell's top-left corner.

getUsedCells.doc: A list of {cx, cy, tile} for every painted cell (or every cell with that tile).

Camera2D.description: Decides which part of a 2D scene is on screen. Put it inside the player to follow them.

current.description: Use this camera. Only one camera is current at a time.

smoothing.description: How slowly the camera catches up: 0 sticks exactly, 5 is smooth.

limitLeft.description: The camera doesn't show anything left of this (empty for no limit).

limitTop.description: The camera doesn't show anything above this.

limitRight.description: The camera doesn't show anything right of this.

limitBottom.description: The camera doesn't show anything below this.

toWorld.doc: A point on the screen, in scene coordinates.

toScreen.doc: A point in the scene, in screen coordinates.

Particles2D.description: Sprays particles: smoke, sparks, dust, rain, explosions.

oneShot.description: Emit one burst of rate particles, then stop.

image.description: The particle image; empty draws soft dots.

speedRandom.description: How much the speed varies (0 to 1).

spread.description: How far directions vary either side.

localCoords.description: Particles move with the node instead of staying where they were born.

restart.doc: Clears all particles and starts again.

CollisionShape2D.description: Gives its parent body or area a shape. A body without one doesn't collide.

CharacterBody2D.description: A body you move with code or a behavior: players and enemies. moveAndSlide() moves it and stops at walls.

floorAngle.description: The steepest slope that still counts as floor.

moveAndSlide.doc: Moves by vx, vy for this frame, sliding along walls and floors.

moveAndCollide.doc: Moves by an offset and stops at the first hit; returns what it hit or nil.

isOnFloor.doc: True if the last move ended standing on something.

isOnWall.doc: True if the last move hit a wall.

isOnCeiling.doc: True if the last move hit a ceiling.

overlaps.doc: The first area or body of a group (or that node) touching this one, or nil.

collided.doc: The body ran into another body or a tile map.

entered.doc: The body started touching an area.

exited.doc: The body stopped touching an area.

StaticBody2D.description: A body that doesn't move by itself: walls, floors, platforms. Moving it with code carries characters standing on it.

friction.description: How much rigid bodies grip it (physics2d).

bounce.description: How much rigid bodies bounce off it (physics2d).

Area2D.description: A region that notices bodies and areas entering and leaving: pickups, triggers, danger zones.

getOverlapping.doc: A list of the bodies and areas inside it now.

overlaps.doc: The first body or area of a group (or that node) inside it, or nil.

entered.doc: A body or area came in.

RigidBody2D.description: A body moved by physics: it falls, bounces, tumbles and pushes. Uses the physics2d module (Box2D).

friction.description: How much it grips other bodies.

bounce.description: How much it bounces: 0 none, 1 forever.

gravityScale.description: How much gravity pulls it; 0 floats.

applyImpulse.doc: A sudden kick, like a jump or a hit.

Joint2D.description: Connects two rigid bodies: a pin, a rope, a spring or a weld. Uses the physics2d module.

nodeB.description: The second body (empty: pinned to the world).

length.description: Rope and spring length; 0 uses the distance when the scene starts.

Node3D.description: A node with a 3D position, rotation and scale. Its children move with it.

y.description: Position, relative to the parent. y is up.

z.description: Position, relative to the parent. -z is forward.

visible.description: Draw this node and its children.

getGlobalPosition.doc: Position in the scene: x, y, z.

setGlobalPosition.doc: Moves the node to a position in the scene.

lookAt.doc: Turns the node so its forward (-z) faces a point.

translate.doc: Moves the node by an offset, in its parent's coordinates.

moveLocal.doc: Moves the node along its own axes.

forward.doc: The direction the node faces (its -z), in the scene: x, y, z.

right.doc: The node's right (+x) direction in the scene.

distanceTo.doc: Distance in meters to another node or a point.

MeshInstance3D.description: Draws a built-in shape: a box, sphere, cylinder, capsule or plane, with a material.

color.description: Base color. Alpha below 1 makes it see-through.

texture.description: An image wrapped around the shape.

emission.description: Light the surface gives off (glows in the dark).

unshaded.description: Ignore lights; show the color as it is.

castShadows.description: Cast shadows from lights that have shadows.

Model3D.description: Draws a 3D model from a glTF (.glb or .gltf) file, with its own materials.

castShadows.description: Cast shadows from lights that have shadows.

Camera3D.description: The point of view of a 3D scene. It looks along its -z axis.

current.description: Use this camera. Only one camera is current at a time.

near.description: Nothing closer than this is drawn.

far.description: Nothing farther than this is drawn.

screenToRay.doc: The ray through a point on the screen: ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz.

worldToScreen.doc: Where a point in the scene is on screen: sx, sy (nil if behind the camera).

DirectionalLight3D.description: Light from far away, like the sun. Only its rotation matters: it shines along its -z axis.

PointLight3D.description: Light shining in every direction from a point, like a lamp or a torch.

SpotLight3D.description: A cone of light, like a flashlight. It shines along its -z axis.

Environment3D.description: The sky, ambient light and fog of a 3D scene. Use one per scene.

background.description: A sky gradient or a flat color.

ambient.description: Light that reaches everywhere, even in shadow.

fog.description: Fade distant things into the fog color.

Sprite3D.description: An image in the 3D world, like a tree in a retro shooter or a health bar over an enemy.

CollisionShape3D.description: Gives its parent 3D body or area a shape. A body without one doesn't collide.

shape.description: The shape's kind. Mesh uses the model or mesh of the parent (static bodies only).

CharacterBody3D.description: A body you move with code or a behavior: a player that walks, jumps and climbs stairs.

maxSlope.description: The steepest slope it can walk up.

stepHeight.description: The highest step it climbs without jumping.

moveAndSlide.doc: Moves by vx, vy, vz for this frame, sliding along walls and up steps.

isOnFloor.doc: True if it's standing on something.

collided.doc: The body ran into another body.

entered.doc: The body started touching an area.

exited.doc: The body stopped touching an area.

RigidBody3D.description: A body moved by physics: crates that fall, roll, stack and get knocked over.

friction.description: How much it grips other bodies.

StaticBody3D.description: A 3D body that doesn't move by itself: floors, walls, the level.

bounce.description: How much bodies bounce off it.

Area3D.description: A 3D region that notices bodies entering and leaving: pickups, checkpoints, triggers.

getOverlapping.doc: A list of the bodies inside it now.

Control.description: The base of UI nodes: a rectangle placed relative to a corner, an edge or the center of the screen.

anchor.description: What the position is measured from. "full" stretches over the whole parent.

width.description: Width (ignored when the anchor is full).

height.description: Height (ignored when the anchor is full).

visible.description: Show this node and its children.

getRect.doc: Where it is on screen now: x, y, width, height.

isHovered.doc: True while the mouse is over it.

Label.description: Text on the screen: scores, timers, titles, dialog.

text.description: What it says. Change it from a script: self.text = `Score: {score}`.

font.description: A .ttf/.otf font, "pixel", or empty for the default font.

outline.description: A dark outline, so it reads on any background.

Button.description: A button to click or tap. Its script gets pressed().

font.description: A font, or empty for the default.

pressed.doc: The button was clicked or tapped.

Panel.description: A colored rectangle behind other UI: a dialog box, a HUD backdrop.

ImageRect.description: An image on the screen: an icon, a portrait, a logo.

fit.description: How the image fills the rectangle.

ProgressBar.description: A bar that fills up: health, loading, a timer.

value.description: How full it is, between min and max.

AudioPlayer.description: Plays a sound or music: a .wav, .ogg or .mp3 file, or a .sfx or .song made in Smitten.

pitch.description: 1 is normal; 2 is an octave up.

play.doc: Plays the sound. Calling it again while playing starts another copy (good for effects).

finished.doc: The sound reached its end (not when looping).

AudioPlayer3D.description: A sound that comes from a place in a 3D scene: louder when the camera is near, and from the left or right.

sound.description: The sound file (mono files work best).

range.description: Beyond this distance it can't be heard.

Platformer.description: Makes its parent CharacterBody2D run and jump with the arrow keys or a gamepad, with gravity.

acceleration.description: How fast it gets up to speed (and stops).

jumpHeight.description: How high a full jump goes.

airJumps.description: Extra jumps in the air (1 is a double jump).

coyoteTime.description: Time after running off a ledge when a jump still works.

controls.description: Read the left, right and jump actions; off lets a script drive it.

jumped.doc: Sent to the parent: it jumped.

landed.doc: Sent to the parent: it landed.

TopDown.description: Makes its parent CharacterBody2D walk in any direction with the arrow keys or a gamepad.

acceleration.description: How fast it gets up to speed (and stops).

rotate.description: Turn the parent to face the way it moves.

controls.description: Read the left, right, up and down actions.

FirstPerson.description: Makes its parent CharacterBody3D walk with WASD, look with the mouse and jump with space. Put a Camera3D in the parent too.

mouseLook.description: Look around with the mouse (click the game to capture the mouse, Escape to free it).

Follow.description: Moves its parent towards another node: enemies that chase, pets, homing missiles. Works in 2D and 3D.

target.description: The node to follow; empty follows the first node in the "player" group.

stopDistance.description: Stop this close to the target.

rotate.description: Turn the parent to face the target.

Mover.description: Moves its parent in a straight line: bullets, clouds, conveyor items.

speed.description: Speed in pixels per second (2D) or meters per second (3D).

useRotation.description: Move the way the parent faces; off moves along direction.

direction.description: Direction when not using the parent's rotation (2D).

destroyOffscreen.description: Destroy the parent once it leaves the screen (2D).

Spin.description: Keeps its parent rotating: coins, fans, saws.

speed.description: Turns per second, in radians (degrees in the inspector).

axis.description: The axis to spin around (3D only).

Draggable.description: Lets the player drag its parent Node2D with the mouse or a finger: card games, puzzles, editors.

size.description: Grab radius when the parent has no collision shape or sprite.

dragStarted.doc: Sent to the parent: the player picked it up.

dragEnded.doc: Sent to the parent: the player let go.
